recap.title: Harlow Cross snatches late 2-2 draw
recap.summary: Verdict: Harlow Cross rescued a dramatic 2-2 draw with a stoppage-time equaliser. 41' — Hartsell’s second yellow (MDU-03) handed Harlow Cross the momentum swing, lifting their win probability from 36% to 49%. 45+2' — Rookwood (MDU-10) struck before half to make it 0-1, taking Marsh Dock United’s win chance from 14% to 52% (assist: Jessop MDU-09). 90+1' — Whitlock (HLC-15) levelled to 2-2 with an assist from Tolliver (HLC-08), moving Harlow Cross from 0% to 8% and sending the draw chance to 89%. Standout performer: Bellweather (HLC-11) was the pick with a 9.2 rating — he forced a 0.76 xG chance at 15' and created the 66' goal that helped turn the game back. What the numbers say: the match finished 2-2, with Harlow Cross piling up 63 % possession, 16 shots and 2.43 xG to Marsh Dock United’s 37 %, 9 shots and 0.73 xG, and the final state left the draw as the full-time result.
